items.category: Daily JUNOS build failures - automated builder use only
items.synopsis: Use latest os-package when upgrading
items.description: Upgrade to 22.3R1 while using os-package published between July 2022 and November 2022 may incorrectly link os-libs package

items.synopsis: Gratuitous ARP reply will not update the ARP cache
items.description: On EX4300 platforms, the ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) cache will not be updated upon receiving the Gratuitous ARP reply even with "gratuitous-arp-reply" configured.

items.synopsis: The interface on the device will go down when one or more interfaces are connected to the Advantech3260 device at another end
items.description: On EX4300 platforms with version 19.1R3 and above, the interface on the device will go down when the device is connected to the Advantech3260 device at the other end. It will have a traffic impact.

items.synopsis: TCAM space might be exhausted when learning DHCP snooping entries on a trusted port
items.description: On EX, QFX5k, and MX platforms having persistent binding for DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) snooping configured might cause TCAM (Ternary Content Addressable Memory) space exhaustion for DHCP snooping learning on the trusted port after the device reboot.

items.synopsis: Dot1x authentication failure for EVPN VXLAN enabled port
items.description: On Junos EX4300-48MP platforms, dot1x authentication fails with EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual extensible LANs) end to end configuration on a user port.

items.synopsis: On Ex2300 and EX3400, "set system ports console log-out-on-disconnect" does not allow user to log in via console.
items.description: On certain units, with "set system ports console log-out-on-disconnect", when you login to the device via a console, the user will be kicked out to the login prompt and be asked to login again.

items.synopsis: On EX3400-24P platforms, the fxpc process crashes after upgrading from 21.4R1.12 to any 22.xRx version except 22.4
items.description: On EX3400-24P platforms, after upgrading from 21.4R1.12 to 22.xRx release and when the cables are plugged/unplugged from the port, the fxpc (Packet Forwarding Engine manager) process crash is seen. The issue will not be seen on the 22.4 release.

items.synopsis: Instability observed after mastership switchover on members with SFP-T pluggable installed on EX4600-VC
items.description: On Junos EX4600 Virtual Chassis (VC), a routing engine master switchover may lead members to disconnect from the VC for approx. 2 mins before the members re-join the VC. This instability will lead to traffic loss. This only happens on members with SFP-T pluggable installed.

items.synopsis: Fabric monitoring suspension and control link failure may cause HA cluster outage
items.description: In HA cluster, a local node failure which causes control link to go down may not guarantee the other node to take over primary if the fabric link monitoring suspension was triggered earlier before (e.g. - caused by a minor hardware failure), as the fabric link down event would be ignored when the other node was in RG0 ineligible state. This is a corner case to https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/software/junos/chassis-cluster-security-devices/topics/topic-map/security-chassis-cluster-failover-parameters.html#id-understanding-chassis-cluster-control-link-heartbeats-failure-and-recovery__d27575e82. And PR1698797 fixed this defect.

items.synopsis: BFD sessions will remain down in the EVPN-VxLAN scenario
items.description: On QFX 10008 and QFX10016 platforms, in a distributed mode Bidirectional Forwarding Detection(BFD) session might remain down if the anchor FPC and the FPC where BFD packets are received over Virtual Tunnel Endpoint (VTEP) are different.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop is observed after deleting or deactivating the logical interface
items.description: On Junos QFX10K platforms configured with multiple logical interfaces (IFLs) on the same physical interface (IFD), if any one of the logical interfaces (IFL) is deleted or deactivated, it will cause a complete traffic drop on the other IFLs of the same IFD.

items.category: Virtual-chassis platform/chassisd infrastructure PRs for MX
items.synopsis: The PFE I/O chip setup failed for some interfaces and causes those interfaces missing in PFE after backup chassis upgraded via Sequential Upgrade
items.description: When the MX virtual-chassis was upgraded by using the Sequential Upgrade method, there is the possibility that PFE provisioning may start before link training completes and all PICs are online. In such scenario, the ifd provisioning is preserved and if the preserved state is applied to the PFE before fabric training has completed and all the PICs have been powered on, ifd missing errors will be seen.

items.category: Virtual-chassis platform/chassisd infrastructure PRs for MX
items.synopsis: MX-VC: The backup VC router could become master after the system reboot
items.description: On Junos MX platforms when VC (Virtual Chassis) configuration is done and after the VC membership election, when routers are rebooted, the previously elected primary router will become the backup router and the backup router will come up as the primary router.

items.synopsis: The oid tree jnxCosQstatEntry returns nothing for some interfaces after restarting class-of-service
items.description: The oid tree jnxCosQstatEntry returns nothing for some interfaces after restarting class-of-service.

items.synopsis: The dot1x reauthentication will not work for a port with VoIP VLAN
items.description: On Junos EX platforms, the dot1x clients will remain in connecting state after the 'clear dot1x interface' is done due to which the interface would not get authenticated to become a member of the configured access VLAN. When this happens, VLAN membership will not be formed.

items.synopsis: Dot1x memory is spiking up even after clearing the dot1x sessions
items.description: Memory leaks were observed in the following two scenarios: i) The command "clear dot1x interface" leaks 1280 bytes every time it is issued. ii) When dot1x is configured for a single supplicant mode on an interface, and then deleted, there is a memory leak of 8kb (8192 bytes) + 28 bytes every rotation.

items.synopsis: Node Slicing: In a rare scenario, the FPC/SLC will get stuck in the ready state after a restart
items.description: On Junos MX platforms, in a rare scenario, FPC/SLC (Flexible PIC Concentrator/Sub Line Card) may get stuck in the ready state after restarting it and the error message of 'Device busy' will be observed in Syslog.

items.synopsis: The Unicast traffic is dropped on QFX5100/EX46xx-VC platforms
items.description: On QFX5100/EX46xx Junos platforms configured with Virtual Chassis(VC), if a master member is unplugged or forced to power off, the unicast traffic is dropped due to mac-persistence-timer expiry there is a difference in mac addresses between logical aggregated parent interface and member aggregated ethernet(ae) interface.

items.synopsis: Deactivating and activating the GRES causes churn in dfwd filter addition/deletion
items.description: On all Junos dual-RE platforms, when performing activate/deactivate Graceful Routing Engine Switchover (GRES) multiple times synchronization issues are observed between the master and backup dfwd process.

items.synopsis: CoS rewrite rules will not work in L3VPN scenario
items.description: On Junos OS ACX710/ACX5448 platforms, in Layer 3 Virtual Private Network (L3VPN) scenario, Class of Service (CoS) Experimental (EXP) rewrite rules configuration will not take effect. Thus CoS remarking will not work properly leading to the wrong remarking on Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) packets.

items.synopsis: MPC11E goes offline with "fpc-slice" configured
items.description: On MX2020 platforms with MPC11E in the Junos Node Slicing environment, when "fpc-slice" is configured results in MPC11E going offline.

items.synopsis: The mgd core might be observed on EVO platforms
items.description: On all EVO platforms, the mgd core might be observed, when repetitive netconf private session edits + commits is performed.

items.synopsis: ARP/ND doesn't resolve when extended-vlan-list is configured for the specific VLAN
items.description: On all Junos & Junos Evolved platforms, ARP(Address resolution protocol)/ND(Neighbour discovery) doesn't resolve when extended-vlan-list is configured for the specific VLAN(virtual local area network).

items.synopsis: The vmcore might be seen with the back-to-back reboot
items.description: On the EX4100 platform with VC setup, upon continuous back-to-back switch reboot, vmcore might be noticed when the switch boots back. The vmcore might lead to a kernel crash.

items.synopsis: On a PVLAN with DAI ARP packets will be forwarded between isolated ports
items.description: On Junos based EX platforms, when Dynamic ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) Inspection (DAI) is configured on PVLAN (Private Virtual Local Area Network), ARP packets coming from the LAG (Link Aggregation Group) are forwarded to other isolated access ports.

items.synopsis: Traffic drops observed with hierarchal overlay ECMP configuration
items.description: On EX4400 platforms in the EVPN-VXLAN environment, the overlay ECMP (equal-cost multipath) route does not get programmed in hardware resulting in traffic drops when hierarchal overlay ECMP is configured.

items.category: EX Entry Level Access VC platform
items.synopsis: The PXE BIOS recovery fails on EX9204/9208/9214 VC setup
items.description: On EX9204/9208/9214 platforms configured in a Virtual Chassis(VC) setup, if the SSD(solid-state drive) local disk is erased or there is a hardware failure for EX9200-40XS FPC, the EX9200-40XS recovery will fail if performed through the PXE(Preboot Execution Environment) and stuck in a boot loop.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is observed when the ECMP path is IRB over AE (IPv4 -> MPLS)
items.description: On QFX10002 platforms, when the ECMP (Equal-cost multi-path) path is IRB (Integrated routing and bridging) over AE (Aggregated Ethernet) {IPv4 -> MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching)} results in packets getting discarded for which traffic loss is observed.

items.synopsis: MACsec on logical interfaces fails after port flap
items.description: MACsec configured on logical interfaces (IFL) would fail to restore after a flap of the parent physical interface. This will lead to Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) errors and failure to pass traffic.

items.synopsis: The user-defined speed does not take effect on the AE interface in certain scenarios on Junos platforms
items.description: On Junos platforms supporting GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover), the bandwidth flag on the backup RE (Routing Engine) for the AE interfaces is set unconditionally, hence the bandwidth is struck at a value despite not being set by the user statically. When GRES is performed followed by link delete/add for the AE interface, the interface would get stuck with the bandwidth and gets synced with the backup RE. There can be seen partial service impact in the case of the RSVP (Resource Reservation Protocol) and the restoration to recover from this issue is to configure bandwidth manually and then remove the configuration.

items.synopsis: The protocol MTU for the IRB interface is not rolled back when the MTU of the IRB or IFD interfaces is modified or deleted
items.description: On all Junos platforms, the maximum transmission unit (MTU) on the Integrated Routing and Bridging (IRB) interface is not getting reset when the MTU configuration on IRB or IFD is removed. When MTU configuration is removed from the IRB interface, the internal data structure for the MTU configuration is not getting reset which might affect traffic and it is a rare case.

items.synopsis: Wrong SRTE Secondary path weight makes the secondary path active in forwarding table
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, SRTE (Segment Routing Traffic Engineering) Secondary LSP (Label Switched Path) should be only on standby in the forwarding table however it is also active and forwarding traffic due to the wrong metric calculation.

items.synopsis: IPv4 ALQ not working with authentication
items.description: IPv4 ALQ not working with authentication. The below error would be seen on the backup router: "Message failed sanity test - the access-profile info is invalid. length:0 "

items.synopsis: A dcd process crash is observed continuously when the dhcp-service is restarted
items.description: On MX platforms that support Broadband Edge (BBE) functionality, the dcd crash continuously occurs when the subscribers are logged in using the DHCP dynamic profile and dhcp-service is restarted having the configuration like "set chassis network-services enhanced-ip" enabled.

items.synopsis: Application traffic drop seen on all SRX platforms due to TCP window size issue
items.description: On all SRX platforms, on rare occasions, after the SYN-ACK is established with the application server, the server will cause the TCP window size drop to zero after declaring a larger initial TCP window in the ACK packet. Though this is not prohibited but generally not expected behavior. Due to this, the packet will be dropped for that particular session.

items.synopsis: The user authentication page is not rendering on the client browser
items.description: On all Junos SRX platforms due to cross-origin restriction access, the domain page does not load. The issue happened due to a firewall authentication failure.

items.synopsis: New secondary node to go into a disabled state after ISSU and failover RG0 because of fabric link failure
items.description: On SRX5K platforms with SPC3 card, the primary node will lose the backup node and fabric link failure is observed resulting in the new secondary node going into a disabled state after ISSU (In-Service Software Upgrade) and failover RG0 (redundancy group) in a chassis cluster environment.

items.synopsis: Chassis cluster IP monitoring on the secondary node failed after the system reboot on the SRX platforms
items.description: On SRX platforms, IP monitoring on the secondary node failed when a Reth (redundant Ethernet) interface consists of two or more than two interfaces on each node. Reth member interface which has a higher port number cannot receive ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) packet used for IP monitoring, which will then put the system in an error state.

items.synopsis: Vmcore is seen on Junos platforms when data plane IPSec is configured
items.description: On Junos platforms, when data plane IPsec (IP Security) is configured, the IP layer passes bad mbuf information to the IPsec layer causing the core which is triggered by data plane ESP (Encapsulating Security Payload) packets coming to RE (Routing Engine).

items.category: Port-based link layer security services and protocols that a
items.synopsis: MACSec session will not come up on the new fallback key during the primary key transition
items.description: On all Junos and Evolved platforms, during the primary key transition on the MACSec session, when a new fallback key is updated on the MACSec peers the session will not come up due to the primary key remaining live on the same interface. When this happens, there will be a traffic drop on the MACSec interface. This is a rare issue and only occurs when a certain sequence of steps is performed.

items.category: Port-based link layer security services and protocols that a
items.synopsis: dot1xd.core-tarball.0.tgz is observed in 22.1R3 at #0x009113f0 in __mem_assert()
items.description: MACSec dot1xd restarts unexpectedly with the _mem_assert( ) in the free_jemalloc(). This happens when an authentication request comes in right after the dot1xd restart.

items.synopsis: The rpd crash will be observed during the MPLS label block allocation
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms in the Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) scenario, the rpd crash will happen in rare conditions during MPLS label block allocation.

items.synopsis: The rpd core and traffic loss is observed on Junos and Junos Evolved platforms
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS platforms, if an LSP (Label-Switched-Path) is configured and delegated to an external controller is disabled (not deleted from configuration), and then a rpd restart or RE (Routing Engine) switchover takes place, the rpd process crashes and generates core resulting in traffic loss.

items.synopsis: Memory leak issue in TED
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, a memory leak is observed in TED (Traffic Engineering Database) when the inet tables is not cleaned up after routing instance deactivation.

items.synopsis: The command "request system zeroize" might not work properly on EX4400.
items.description: When issuing the "request system zeroize" command, an error message might be seen.

items.synopsis: LDP flaps will be observed having LT interface with VLAN and LDP running between the logical-system instance and global instance
items.description: On Junos platforms, when the LT (Logical Tunnel) interface with VLAN and LDP (Label Distribution Protocol) is configured between the logical-system instance and global instance LDP flaps are observed.

items.synopsis: BGP session flap with error BGP_IO_ERROR_CLOSE_SESSION
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, a random BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) session flaps will be observed immediately after committing certain configuration changes with the error "BGP_IO_ERROR_CLOSE_SESSION" along with a TCP connection reset. This issue is generic to any TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) connection that has MD5 (Message-Digest Algorithm) enabled on it, eg targeted LDP. Following error is also reported: rpd: bgp_pp_recv: rejecting connection from a.b.c.d (Internal AS xyz), peer in state Established rpd: bgp_pp_recv:5159: NOTIFICATION sent to a.b.c.d+64150 (proto): code 6 (Cease) subcode 5 (Connection Rejected)

items.category: Provider Backbone (PBB) EVPN PFE functionality on MX
items.synopsis: PBB-EVPN PE cannot learn remote CE MAC address due to ARP suppression enabled
items.description: In PBB-EVPN (Provider Backbone Bridging - Ethernet VPN) environment, ARP suppression feature which is not supported by PBB might be enabled unexpectedly. This could cause MAC addresses of remote CEs not to be learned and hence traffic loss.

items.synopsis: The fxpc coredump is generated and an FPC restart results in traffic impact
items.description: On all Junos platforms, when Ethernet Ring Protection (ERPS) is configured and the CLI command 'request support information' is executed, a coredump is generated and the FPC restarts, affecting traffic.

items.synopsis: On QFX5110-VC-VCF platforms, traffic impact is seen when the firewall filter with DSCP action is enabled
items.description: On QFX5100-VC-VCF (Virtual-Chassis Fabric) when the firewall filter with action DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) is configured and is applied to any interface, the commit check gives a warning on FPC2 (Flexible PIC Concentrators) if the master has member id 0 and traffic drop can be seen.

items.synopsis: PFE crash is seen on all Junos QFX5K and EX46xx platforms with L2PT configuration
items.description: PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) crashes on all Junos QFX5K and EX46xx platforms when L2PT (Layer 2 Protocol Tunneling) is configured on the interface having flexible-vlan-tagging with encapsulation extended-vlan-bridge. It causes a traffic impact.

items.synopsis: VSTP will not work in the EVPN-VxLAN network
items.description: On all Junos QFX5K platforms, when using transparent mode EVPN-VxLAN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network-Virtual extensible LANs), the tagged BPDUs (Bridge Protocol Data Units) are dropped instead of being pushed into the VxLAN tunnel. This issue might affect all the services related to L2PT (Layer Two Protocol Tunneling).

items.synopsis: VC members are reloading randomly
items.description: On QFX5110 platforms, in a rare scenario, VC (Virtual Chassis) members are getting reloaded as the PRIVATE PFEMAN sockets related to the VC are getting dropped.

items.synopsis: All members of the VCF will not reboot on QFX5k platforms
items.description: On QFX5k platforms with VCF(Virtual Chassis Fabric), when "request system reboot at now" CLI is executed from any member of VC then it will be pushed to all other members of VC. But sometimes member from which CLI is executed goes into a reboot so CLI can't be pushed to other members until it comes up again, when "request system reboot" without "at now" works as expected. This command should not be used in VC as some members will not reboot or there may be a time delay between reboot of members which will make VC unstable.

items.category: RPD infrastructure issues related to NSR, GRES, switchover,
items.synopsis: The rpd crash will be observed when any commit is performed
items.description: On all Junos and Evolved platforms with RSVP auto-mesh dynamic tunnel configuration, whenever a commit is done the rpd (Routing Process Daemon) crash will be seen. This happens due to null pointer access in the memory.

items.synopsis: The rpd crash is observed when rib-sharding configured
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, rpd crash observed while configuring BGP rib-sharding as route re-resolve happens due to another best match route. Traffic drop can be seen during rpd process recovery.

items.synopsis: The rpd crash would be observed in a RSVP scenario
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with RSVP enabled, the rpd (routing protocol daemon) crash will be observed while updating the RSVP path information with a new metric. When this happens, the core files are generated and some traffic loss will be seen.

items.category: Generic platform and infra issues for MS-MIC and MS-MPC(XLP)
items.synopsis: Transit tunnels fails and remains down on all Junos based MX and SRX platform with IKE-NAT-ALG enabled
items.description: On all Junos based MX and SRX platforms, the transit tunnels are not getting established and remained down due to a 10240 IKE (Internet Key Exchange) cookie limitation on MX-SPC3 and 10240 cookie limitation on the SRX platform. IKE tunnel sessions are getting dropped on the device and caused a traffic impact.

items.synopsis: The process srxpfd/ flowd will crash on SRX devices
items.description: On all SRX platforms (except branch SRX series) configured with chassis cluster redundancy group, when numerous logical interfaces or IFLs (> 1K) are deleted and traffic is running for those IFLs, or if the RG failover then the process srxpfed/ flowd will crash.

items.synopsis: The flowd crash and core will be observed when TLS 1.3 session ticket is received on SSL-I
items.description: On SRX platforms with SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) Proxy configured, due to timing sync issues, if TLS (Transport Layer Security) 1.3 session ticket is received on the server (SSL-Initiator), while on the client (SSL-Terminator) TLS 1.2 handshake is finished, proxy session info is cleared resulting in core when saving session ticket in the session cache.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is seen due to interface flap when changing speed from 10G and 1G
items.description: On Junos MX204, traffic loss is seen on 4x10G Channelized interfaces when the speed is changed from 10G to 1G on one lane which causes the other 3 lanes to flap and stay down.

items.category: SRX-1RU platfom related protocol, QoS, filtering features et
items.synopsis: SRX4600HA might not failover properly due to a hardware failure
items.description: In SRX4600 platform, there is a possibility of raising alarm function might not work in FPGA failure. It might affect device availability.

items.synopsis: The firewall bridge filter policers (attached to AE interface) are not working on all Junos MX platform with MPC10 card upon deactivate-activate a term intended to limit overall traffic
items.description: Traffic policing will not work as expected on all Junos MX platform with MPC10 card after doing deactivation-activation of the term intended to limit overall traffic when the firewall and policers are applied to the bridge unit using shared-bandwidth-policers on AE (Aggregated Ethernet) interface.

items.synopsis: The FPC crash is observed with out-of-bound access to the filter action table
items.description: On all Junos platforms with MPC10 and above line cards, the FPC crashed due to out-of-bound filter access observed during back-to-back GRES operations.

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is seen on MPC10E due to null pointer access without any safe check
items.description: On the Junos MX series platforms with MPC10/11, when the line card is inserted, it restarts and traffic loss is seen generating the core dump due to the null pointer access without any safe check.

items.synopsis: FPC restart and core dump generated in MPLS scaled scenario with "always-mark-connection-protection-tlv" configured
items.description: FPC restart and core dump generated in MPLS scaled scenario with "always-mark-connection-protection-tlv" configured.

items.synopsis: Test Configuration might fail even though the config file is having valid configurations
items.description: Root cause; In test configuration flow we are calling mustd as "/usr/sbin/mustd -q /var/run/db/file.data /var/run/db/file.data+ -F -m" where we just copy the existing cog.db (generated out of committed config) as cdg.db+ , use it for testing the configuration passed, and remove it once the testing is done. This is creating the issue because the configuration is tested against the existing cdg.db. Fix would be to create the cdg.db fresh from the configuration to be tested and test the configuration against that. This new cdg.db should not replace the existing one in /var/run/db.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: Configuration filtering doesn't work when the logical system is present
items.description: On SRX platforms, configuration filtering doesn't work when the logical system is present.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The mgd process might crash during commit synchronize
items.description: On all Junos OS and Evolved OS platforms with dual RE (Routing Engine) during commit script synchronize, backup RE mgd get crash once the memory leak reaches to 65K due to which commit configuration will fail which are performed through Master RE.

items.category: For GPRS security features on highend SRX series
items.synopsis: GTPv2 Message Filtering is not working
items.description: GTPv2 Message Filtering not working - resolved

items.synopsis: On EX4300 platforms, continuous MACsec interfaces flaps over an extended period of time
items.description: On EX4300, MACsec enabled interfaces flaps continuously over an extended period of time(~24 hours) may result in PFE core and IFDs going down.

items.synopsis: Alarms were not generated as expected when the Management Interface Link was down
items.description: On Junos EX3400 device, whenever the Management Interface Link is Down, the alarm was not getting generated as expected.

items.synopsis: EX4600-VC - Master RE reboot and All-member reboot lead to PFE Manager hogging logs when SFP-T is plugged in
items.description: On Junos EX4600 Virtual Chassis (VC), the master RE reboot and all-members reboot lead to the PFE Manager hogging logs when SFP-T pluggable is installed in. The PFE Manager hogging logs has no functionality impact (PR 1641556).

items.synopsis: EVPN Packets may go to incorrect queues due to the wrong classification and may lead to packets drop during congestion
items.description: On Junos ACX5448 and ACX710 devices, in EVPN (Ethernet Virtual private network) with a multihoming scenario, if one link fails traffic will switch over to another link. When FPC is restarted and the dot1p classifier is changed, restore the failed link. Packets may not go to the correct queue due to the wrong classification when traffic switches back to the original link, and traffic drops may happen during congestion.

items.synopsis: 'OSPF Route Type Extended Community' cannot be configured as 'rte-type'
items.description: The issue is not addressed for 22.1R3 and will be addressed in future releases

items.synopsis: BGP LU Advertisements fail with the message "BGP label allocation failure: Need a gateway"
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms BGP-LU (Border Gateway Protocol Labeled-Unicast) Advertisements fail with the message "BGP label allocation failure: Need a gateway" based on timing conditions involving route resolution and installation.

items.synopsis: EX/QFX SNMP: jnxOperatingDescr.1.1.0.0 returns blank, but jnxOperatingState.1.1.0.0 returns value.
items.description: On EX/QFX series switch, jnxOperatingDescr.1.1.0.0 returns blank, but jnxOperatingState.1.1.0.0 returns value.

items.synopsis: On PTX5000 platforms when a command is issued to power off an FPC, it gets stuck in the 'Announce Offline' state
items.description: When an FPC (Flexible PIC Concentrator) on PTX5000 platforms is shut down by issuing a request command (request chassis offline slot ) or by FPC power off configuration (set chassis fpc x power off), it gets stuck in the 'Announce Offline' state since the associated timer (fru_graceful_offline_timer) doesn't increment and expire as it is supposed to.

items.synopsis: A major alarm DPDK (data plane development kit) Tx stuck issue of SRX4100/4200
items.description: On the SRX4100 and SRX4200 platforms, it can detect DPDK (data plane development kit) Tx stuck issue and trigger a major chassis alarm goes which might trigger RG1 failover to the healthy node. A DPDK reset will be triggered only to the stuck port and if the reset resolves the tx stuck issue, the major chassis alarm will go off.

items.synopsis: TCP session timeout seen on GRE tunnel
items.description: On GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) tunnel, TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) session lasts only 20sec and the session timeout seen due to high latency observed.

items.category: all logging related bugs on srx platforms
items.synopsis: SRX5600/5800 - SNMP mib queries may result in occasional response timeouts
items.description: SRX5600/5800 - SNMP MIB queries for jnxJsSPUMonitoringMIB objects (1.3.6.1.4.1.2636.3.39.1.12.1.x) may result in occasional response timeouts

items.synopsis: 22.4R1:SRX_RIAD:srx5600:MN_HA:ike cookies didn't change in rekey lifetime expire cases after manual failover
items.description: Sometimes after manual failover, IKE-SA rekey does not succeed. In order to recover from this scenario, enable dead-peer-detection with always-send

items.synopsis: In the rare scenario, huge PTP Time errors are introduced and propagated to the downstream devices after the chassis reboot
items.description: On MX240, MX480, MX960, MX2010, and MX2020 platforms, the remote PTP (Precision Time Protocol) clock will recover the PTP clock with Time errors after a chassis reboot on the device running as Boundary Clock.

items.synopsis: A rare corner case would lead to the restart of the device with a VMCORE crash
items.description: On EX3400-48P or EX3400-48T or EX-3400-24T platforms, a rare corner case, would lead to the restart of the device with a VMCORE crash.

items.synopsis: OSPF routes are not getting installed after the interface is flapped
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, the OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) routes are not getting installed when the interface is flapped multiple times. A deadlock is created when the OSPF routers wait for an LSA (Link State Advertisement) with a P2P (Point-to-Point) link to be advertised from its neighbouring router to add it to its router LSA and at the same time the neighbouring router also waits for an LSA with a P2P link to be advertised to add it to its router LSA. Both the OSPF routers advertise their router LSA without a P2P link and as a result, routes are not getting installed.

items.synopsis: BFD session session-state is showing DOWN while checking Micro BFD Sessions with Authentication in Non-Distributed Mode
items.description: BFD session session-state is showing DOWN when operating in centralized Mode. Packet loss may be seen.

items.synopsis: Sflow ingress/egress sampling not working when ECMP nexthops are involved
items.description: Sflow ingress/egress sampling not working when ECMP nexthops are involved.

items.synopsis: jsd memory leak and may lead jsd restart.
items.description: You may see memory usage of jsd is increasing gradually. When the jsd process crashes, it will restart automatically.

items.synopsis: [EVPNVXLAN_L2Stitching]: Local DHCP binding is not happening from pool specific to the VRF
items.description: DHCP relay processing in EVPN/VXLAN environments with multiple VRFs on QFX switches requires the use of forwarding-options dhcp-relay group [GROUP] interface [irb.xxx] configuration

items.synopsis: BGP session may not establish between loopback interfaces when routes are learnt through type5 EVPN routes
items.description: On QFX5k platforms, BGP session may not establish between loopback interfaces when routes are learnt through type5 EVPN routes.

items.synopsis: Intra VLAN communication breaks in SP style config using VXLAN
items.description: Change from Enterprise (EP) to Service Provider (SP) style configuration result in reachability issue in pure L2 (Virtual Extensible LAN protocol) VXLAN setup.

items.synopsis: Restarting FPC or router reboot might causes some CCC interfaces to go down due to a 'Remote CCC down'
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, if CCC (Circuit Cross-Connect) is configured to use a label-switched-path such as IGP routed, i.e., no-cspf and no strict ERO (Explicit Route Object) configuration, then restarting egress CCC node or restarting FPC on the egress CCC node containing remote-interface-switch configuration multiple times may cause CCC to remain stuck in remote-if-down state, resulting in loss of traffic. (The knob 'remote-interface-switch' is configured on the egress LER of the RSVP-TE LSP (Resource Reservation Protocol-Traffic Engineering label-switched-path) which binds the LSP terminating on the node to a local interface).

items.category: Generic platform and infra issues for MS-MIC and MS-MPC(XLP)
items.synopsis: PFE crash will be observed when pinging the local interface with an MTU of size greater than interface MTU
items.description: On MX platforms, while pinging the local interface, when the control plane sends packets(ICMP reply) whose size is greater than the interface MTU PFE will crash.

items.category: ZT/YTpfe bridging, learning, stp, oam, irb software
items.synopsis: VLAN tags are imposed incorrectly when traffic is routed over IRB going out of the access interface
items.description: On MX platforms, traffic egressing on the IRB (Integrated Routing and Bridging) interface with the underlying L2 (layer2) access port has VLAN tags imposed incorrectly.

items.category: Trio pfe bridging, learning, stp, oam, irb software
items.synopsis: Egress traffic loss might happen because of PFE MTU feature problem
items.description: On MX and EX9200 serial platforms, under Ethernet VPN (EVPN) environment, packets routed using IRB interface could not be fragmented due to media maximum transmission unit (MTU) problem.
